WITH totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(articount) as total_artifacts
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE articount IS NOT NULL
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    articount,
    CAST(articount AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total_artifacts FROM totals) as share
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE articount IS NOT NULL
    AND (SELECT total_artifacts FROM totals) IS NOT NULL
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_value
  FROM shares
)
SELECT 
  zoneref,
  articount,
  share,
  share - (SELECT avg_share_value FROM avg_share) as share_difference
FROM shares
WHERE (SELECT avg_share_value FROM avg_share) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  share_difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
